vectors.name: asked_to_be_paid
vectors.why: The payee's agent asks for the agreed amount at a place its owner signed. The request stays completed.

vectors.name: asked_then_received
vectors.why: Only the payee's word that it arrived marks it received, apart from the state.

vectors.name: received_with_no_ask
vectors.why: A payee can say a payment arrived that it never asked for here.

vectors.name: asked_at_a_lightning_address
vectors.why: Each kind of place is taken by its shape.

vectors.name: asked_on_a_chain
vectors.why: An address on a chain, as CAIP-2 names the chain.

vectors.name: a_fourth_ask_is_past_the_cap
vectors.why: Three asks for one value bound what a fooled payee agent can say this way.

vectors.name: asked_before_it_was_completed
vectors.why: Nothing is owed until the payer's owner signs.

vectors.name: asked_by_the_payer
vectors.why: Only the side a value is paid to can ask for it.

vectors.name: asked_on_a_type_nobody_pays
vectors.why: A type with no paid value has nothing to ask for.

vectors.name: asked_for_another_amount
vectors.why: The amount is the agreed terms', which the reader works out for itself.

vectors.name: asked_in_another_unit
vectors.why: So is the currency.

vectors.name: asked_with_another_reference
vectors.why: The reference comes from the request's ID.

vectors.name: asked_at_a_place_not_listed
vectors.why: The place has to be one the statement lists.

vectors.name: asked_with_a_reference_of_another_shape
vectors.why: Code writes the reference, in one shape.

vectors.name: place_signed_by_the_agent_key
vectors.why: Only the payee's owner says where they get paid.

vectors.name: place_signed_by_someone_elses_owner
vectors.why: Another owner's statement isn't this payee's.

vectors.name: place_with_a_login_in_it
vectors.why: No password rides in a payment page's address.

vectors.name: place_on_plain_http
vectors.why: A payment page is https.

vectors.name: place_in_prose
vectors.why: A Lightning address is one address, not words around it.

vectors.name: five_places
vectors.why: At most four places.

vectors.name: one_place_twice
vectors.why: Each place once.

vectors.name: bank_details
vectors.why: Bank details aren't a kind Splint takes.

vectors.name: asked_naming_a_step_not_held
vectors.why: One that names a step this reader doesn't hold waits for it.

vectors.name: received_said_by_the_payer
vectors.why: Only the payee says it arrived.

vectors.name: one_ask_twice
vectors.why: An ask is held once, so a replay of it is refused, not counted towards the cap.

vectors.name: statement_past_1536_bytes
vectors.why: A statement fits beside the rest of a step.

vectors.name: statement_spelled_with_spaces
vectors.why: One encoding, so spare bytes can't ride on it.

vectors.name: statement_of_another_version
vectors.why: Only version 1 is read.

vectors.name: statement_naming_another_owner
vectors.why: Signed by this owner's key, but naming someone else.

vectors.name: statement_with_no_places
vectors.why: At least one place.

vectors.name: offer_with_a_space_in_it
vectors.why: An offer is bech32's characters alone, so no words ride on one.

vectors.name: offer_in_capitals
vectors.why: In lower case, as bech32 writes it here.

vectors.name: offer_with_an_at_in_it
vectors.why: A start of lno1 is an offer's alone, so it's never read as a Lightning address.

vectors.name: lightning_domain_in_capitals
vectors.why: A Lightning address is lower case throughout.

vectors.name: page_with_a_space_in_it
vectors.why: A payment page holds only what a URL holds unescaped.

vectors.name: page_with_a_port_of_letters
vectors.why: A port is digits.

vectors.name: chain_in_capitals
vectors.why: A CAIP-2 namespace is lower case.

vectors.name: chain_address_with_an_angle_bracket
vectors.why: An address is CAIP-10's characters alone.

vectors.name: asset_that_isnt_a_word
vectors.why: The asset is a word.

vectors.name: statement_dated_within_the_clock_tolerance
vectors.why: A clock a little ahead is allowed for.

vectors.name: statement_dated_after_its_ask
vectors.why: Past the clock tolerance.

vectors.name: statement_dated_at_2_63
vectors.why: Every reader refuses it, however it holds numbers.

vectors.name: statement_dated_at_2_64
vectors.why: Past any reader's numbers.

vectors.name: asked_by_the_payer_when_both_owners_signed
vectors.why: Only the side a value is paid to can ask for it, whoever signed.

vectors.name: asked_by_the_payee_when_both_owners_signed
vectors.why: The same type, asked by the side it pays.

vectors.name: asked_of_a_payer_whose_owner_never_signed
vectors.why: Nobody is asked to pay what their owner never agreed, though the payee's owner did.

vectors.name: asked_by_a_payee_whose_owner_is_a_stand_in
vectors.why: No owner has confirmed a stand-in, so none has signed where one gets paid.

vectors.name: asked_for_the_delivered_amount
vectors.why: A result's amount is what's owed, over the offer's.

vectors.name: asked_for_the_offered_amount_after_another_was_delivered
vectors.why: The offer's amount no longer stands once another was delivered and signed.
